reason.description: Plain language, e.g. 'They offered 4pm. You said before 3pm.' (DC-5)

field_requested.description: Profile field key when the trigger is an ask-first field (DC-6)

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The tier behind this call. Stored backend-only (agent_scores); never in the card or the push (DC-4, DC-5)

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: The six DC-4 answers behind the confidence tier. Logged for debugging, never shown to the user.

offer.title: HeardOffer
offer.description: The offer exactly as the other side said it, written as data. Fill a field only when they said it or it is clear from the call ("Thursday" on a call about Thursday 19 November). Leave out anything you are unsure of. Never your own judgment.

time.description: The offered start time, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 15:00 for 3pm

party_size.description: How many people the offer is for

person.description: Who it is with, as they said it, e.g. Dr. Patel
